critique.evidence: The dark grid, restrained cyan/mint/red palette, monospace labeling, selected-row treatment, and bordered comparison panels create a coherent technical identity across all viewports. However, the desktop navigation bar visibly bisects and obscures the oversized hero headline, while the tablet navigation overflows/clips horizontally. Mobile reflows the event table into cards successfully, but typography becomes extremely small and dense, with weak separation between metadata, values, and actions across a very long page. These responsive defects and inconsistent header composition keep it below demo-ready polish.
critique.fix: Prevent the header from overlaying hero content and replace the tablet/mobile navigation with an intentional condensed menu. Set viewport-specific headline sizing and line breaks, then increase mobile body/metadata sizes and spacing. Strengthen card hierarchy by grouping each event’s primary identity, amount, risk, and decision into clearer rows while preserving the current palette and visual system.
